sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238943
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 25099 of 2023

Applicant :- Radhey Shyam
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Janam Shahi,Jawahar Lal Yadava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Jawahar Lal Yadava, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S. B. Singh, learned Aga
for the State-respondent.

2.  The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
250 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC & 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Didarganj, District Azamgarh, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR marriage of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 7.11.2021 and after marriage applicant and his family members tortured her for a bullet motorcycle and a golden chain and on 25.9.2022 village pradhan informed the informant that applicant and his family members committed the murder of his daughter.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and only being husband of the deceased he has been made accused in Radhey Shyam vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71131026/
1 the present matter.

entities.text: Radhey Shyam vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. He further submitted that actually at the time of incident applicant was in Ludhiyana and after receiving information he came back to his house.

6. He further submitted that actually deceased insisted to live with the applicant in Ludhiyana but as applicant was a poor labour, therefore, he was not in a position to accommodate her and only due to this reason she committed suicide.
7. He further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.

8. He further pointed out that immediately after the incident family members of the applicant,
informed the informant and after receiving the information, informant arrived at spot and on the information furnished by him inquest was conducted and he was one of the witness of the inquest which was conducted on 26.9.2022 and at that time no objection was raised by the informant but after four days he cooked up the false story and lodged FIR of the present case.
9. He further submitted that delay of four days in lodging the FIR itself suggests that entire story of prosecution is based on false and concocted facts.
10. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 12.10.2022 i.e. for last more than a year.

11. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within a year of her marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but he could not dispute the fact that FIR of the present case was lodged after four days and inquest was prepared on the information furnished by the informant himself and at the time of inquest informant was not only present but he was also one of the panch witnesses.
12. He further could not disputed the fact that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 12.10.2022 i.e. for last more than a year.
13. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

14. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and it appears that his wife died within one year of marriage under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but it further reflects from the record that FIR of the present case was lodged after four days and inquest was prepared even on the information furnished by the informant and he was also one of the inquest witness
therefore, argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant in this regard cannot be completely ruled out, at this stage.

sentences.text: Further, from the post mortem report of the deceased it reflects that she died due to hanging and therefore, possibility cannot be ruled out that it is a case of suicidal death and therefore, in this regard also defence taken by the applicant cannot be completely brushed aside, at this stage.
16. Further, applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 12.10.2022 i.e. for last more than a year.

17. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
18. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

19. Let the applicant-Radhey Shyam, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
20.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

21. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023/Ankita  Radhey Shyam vs State Of U.P. on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/71131026/
